solutions.title: Quadratic transaction DP
solutions.strategy: For each transaction count and sell day, test every earlier buy day against the previous transaction layer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each transaction/day state may scan all earlier buy days.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table stores the best profit by transaction count and day.

solutions.title: Optimized transaction DP
solutions.strategy: Carry the best previous-layer balance while scanning each transaction layer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each transaction layer scans the price list once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: This version keeps the table explicit for clarity.
